sources.entry: slskd ⚠ - A modern client-server application for the Soulseek file sharing network. AGPL-3.0 Docker/C#

summary.one_liner: slskd is a web-accessible, client-server application for the Soulseek peer-to-peer file-sharing network, run as a daemon, Docker container, or binary.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a browser-based interface for searching the Soulseek network, sorting and filtering results, and downloading files. Downloads can be monitored by speed and status, grouped by user and folder, with controls to fetch queue position, cancel, retry, or clear them. The README says it can browse user shares, join chat rooms, and privately chat with other users, covering most of what the official Soulseek client does. Access is secured with a token and the app is described as suitable for internet exposure and reverse proxies. Configuration is stored in a slskd.yml file, and remote configuration from the web UI can be toggled with an environment variable.
use_cases: Searching and downloading files on the Soulseek network
Running a headless Soulseek client on a server or NAS
Managing Soulseek downloads through a web browser
Joining Soulseek chat rooms and private messaging from a browser
how_to_run: Or use docker-compose with the slskd/slskd image, mapping ports 5030, 5031, and 50300
Open the web UI on http://localhost:5030 (HTTPS on 5031) and log in with the default slskd/slskd credentials, then change them
Binaries: download the zip from the releases page, extract it, and run
Edit the generated slskd.yml in the application directory to add Soulseek credentials
notable: Web UI accessible from a browser, designed to be exposed to the internet with token-based security
Multiple search entry and result filtering similar to the official Soulseek client
Download manager grouped by user and folder with queue-position lookup
Docker image with PUID/PGID or built-in user options
caveats: Default credentials slskd/slskd must be changed before internet-facing use
SLSKD_REMOTE_CONFIGURATION lets the web UI change settings, which the README advises against for internet-facing installs
Requires a Soulseek network account configured in slskd.yml; some setup may be needed behind a reverse proxy
